body: 本期彙整3則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

1. 西南航空洛杉磯飛奧蘭多航班　三組搖滾樂團輪番機上演出
Hoobastank、Simple Plan與The Used在西南航空航班演出，班機於全美暫停起飛前離地。

3. 聯航申請限制飛往芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）航班　疏導壅塞後措施已解除
聯合航空因登機門壅塞申請暫緩部分飛往歐海爾航班起飛，並表示限制已結束。

facts.claim: Three bands performed aboard a Southwest flight from Los Angeles to Orlando.
The flight departed before the nationwide FAA ground stop, according to the report.
Seven winter routes include Phoenix–Oaxaca, Miami–Cap-Haïtien, Miami–Barcelona, Chicago–Narita, JFK–Amsterdam, JFK–Tel Aviv and Philadelphia–Porto.
Most remaining starts are scheduled for January or March 2027.
United requested a targeted FAA action limiting some inbound O’Hare flights to prioritize departures.
United confirmed that the targeted ground stop had expired.
